# Solve Linear Eqs

![Solve Linear Eqs function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/linear-algebra/03-solve_linear_equations.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Solves A*X=B with vector or matrix right-hand sides and preserved output rank. General mode 0 uses a rank-revealing least-squares/minimum-norm solve; mode 1 uses the positive-definite system, 2/3 lower/upper triangular. No inverse(A)*B substitution or silent method change. Inputs calculate in DBL/CDB with explicit numeric promotion; 64-bit integers above 2^53 may round. No broadcasting, no private Matrix reinterpretation. error is I32 and never an automatic dialog. Optional unwired defaults: matrix_type=0.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**Solve Linear Eqs**

Résout A·X=B pour un ou plusieurs seconds membres, en conservant le rang de B. Le mode général calcule une solution de moindres carrés et de norme minimale ; les modes positif défini et triangulaires sont explicites. Valeurs facultatives non câblées : matrix_type=0.

</details>
